subject: EU-only operator access attestation + backup retention remediation plan
messages:
From: Diane Lewis <diane.lewis@acmehealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Rossi <m.rossi@medicorp.eu>
Date: Tue, 4 Dec 2028 09:22:00 +0000
Subject: Request: operator access attestation + backup retention evidence

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for taking this on — vendor security flagged a couple of open items for our EU-only processing requirement tied to our Schrems II review. Two asks from our legal/compliance teams:

1) Formal attestation that all operator access (human/ssh/console) for our tenant is logged, limited to EU-based operators, and that logs are retained for a minimum of 12 months.
2) Proof that backups and snapshots containing AcmeHealth customer data are stored only in EU regions, plus a retention/restore matrix for backups (we need RPO/RTO and deletion workflow).

Can you provide an evidence bundle and a short remedial plan if any gaps are found? We have a compliance checkpoint on 12/11 and need a deliverable by 12/8 to share internally.

Attachments: none (we can upload things to the shared Drive link below).

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Diane
Diane Lewis
Head of Vendor Risk, AcmeHealth
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Diane Lewis <diane.lewis@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Dec 2028 10:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: operator access attestation + backup retention evidence

Hi Diane —

We can absolutely provide that. High level plan and immediate next steps:

- Evidence bundle we will upload by 2028-12-07 containing: operator access logs (redacted), operator roster + geo-attestation, backup location manifests, and the retention/deletion matrix.
- If any gaps are identified (e.g., residual operator accounts outside EU), we will provide a remediation timeline within 48 hours of discovery and a mitigation (canary deny + alerting) until fixed.
- We will include our SCCs scope summary and the mapping showing which subprocessors touch AcmeHealth data.

I am looping in Soojin to confirm the log exports and Lauren for legal attestation language. Jordan will coordinate the DocuSign attestation if you want a signed statement.

Deliverables: evidence bundle (12/07), signed attestation (12/09) unless you want faster.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Diane Lewis <diane.lewis@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Dec 2028 13:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: operator access attestation + backup retention evidence

Thanks Naomi / Diane — technical notes on the artifacts we'll include: 

- Operator access: export of privileged access events (console, bastion, sudo) filtered to AcmeHealth tenant ids for 2028-11-01 -> 2028-12-03. Logs include operator id, source IP (geo), action, and session id. We'll redact token/session secrets but keep timestamps and action detail.
- Geo-attestation: list of operator accounts + HR-based location field; where HR location is outside EU we'll include evidence of contractual restriction and current access-block policies.
- Backups: manifest per-day for active snapshots (region tag: eu-west-1 / eu-central-1), S3 bucket listing exports, and the lifecycle policy showing retention + transition. We'll attach the backup-retention-matrix.xlsx with RPO/RTO and deletion trigger points.
- KMS: key IDs used for AcmeHealth objects and confirmation that master keys are in EU KMS.

Known gap: one legacy snapshot archive (snapshot-arch-2025-09) is in a cold region pending migration. We'll include a remediation ticket and ETA (migrate + delete) — targeted completion 2028-12-10.

Soojin
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Diane Lewis <diane.lewis@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Dec 2028 11:02:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Request: operator access attestation + backup retention evidence

Diane —

Attached: draft attestation (eu-operator-attestation-draft.pdf), SCCs scope summary (sccs-scope-summary.pdf), and the backup retention matrix.

Action items for us:
- Naomi / Lauren: finalize attestation language and confirm signatory (we typically sign from Head of Compliance + Legal Counsel).
- Soojin: finalize log export redaction and upload bundles to the Drive link.
- Naomi: confirm whether Acme needs notarized signature or DocuSign envelope.

I created a DocuSign envelope and included the attestation as a draft. Link below; if it's fine to proceed we'll request signatures from Naomi and Lauren and then send the signed PDF back to you.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/ACME/Envelope/12345
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFgEU-ACME-EVIDENCE

Thanks — we aim to have the Drive bundle uploaded by EOD 12/07.

Jordan Blake
Director, Enterprise Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: eu-operator-attestation-draft.pdf (pdf), backup-retention-matrix.xlsx (xlsx), sccs-scope-summary.pdf (pdf)

Jordan / Naomi —

This looks good. Thanks for flagging the legacy archive and the remediation ETA — the compliance checkpoint accepted the mitigation plan contingent on proof of the migration by 12/10. Please proceed with DocuSign for Naomi + Lauren.

I will follow up if EU Compliance Consulting needs anything else, but from our side the artifacts you listed should be sufficient for the legal review.

Diane
